body.name: Fourth-cumulant fiber region
body.construction: Clip every empirical raw moment of total degree one through four to \([-\sqrt{V_8},\sqrt{V_8}]\); compute \(\widehat\kappa_{iTTT}\), replace \(\widehat\kappa_{TTTT}\) by its maximum with \((3/2)a_{\min}^4\), set \(\widehat a_T=(\widehat\kappa_{TTTT}/3)^{1/4}\), \(\widehat a_i=\widehat\kappa_{iTTT}/(3\widehat a_T^3)\), form \(\widehat\Gamma_N^{\mathrm{Lap}}\), and return the declared union \(C_N^{\mathrm{Lap}}\) with radius \(L_\beta C_{\mathrm{Lap}}r_N^{\mathrm{Lap}}\).
inputs: a known literal standardized-Laplace source law
